makemeahanzi.definition: soup, gravy, broth; hot water

characterDeckComponents.note: 氵 (water) shows 汤 relates to a liquid, as in soup or broth.
昜 (yáng) gives a sound distantly related to tāng, having drifted apart over time.

makemeahanzi.definition: beautiful, elegant, magnificent

etymology.hint: Simplified form of 麗; the antlers of a deer 鹿

characterDeckComponents.note: 丽 is the simplified form of 麗, which depicted the ornate antlers of a deer (鹿) — a fitting image behind its meaning 'beautiful, magnificent.'

makemeahanzi.definition: small box or case; casket

characterDeckComponents.note: 皿 (dish, container) — a box is a kind of container.
合 (hé) gives the sound — an exact match for 盒.

makemeahanzi.definition: interjection of surprise

characterDeckComponents.note: 口 (mouth) — 哎 is a sound made with the mouth, an interjection.
艾 (ài) gives a sound close to āi, sharing the same rhyme with a different tone.

makemeahanzi.definition: to wander, to travel, to tour, to roam

etymology.hint: To swim freely 斿 through the seas 氵

characterDeckComponents.note: 氵 (water) — the sea or river being traveled through
斿 — a banner streaming in the wind, evoking free, drifting movement

makemeahanzi.definition: name, family name, surname; clan, people

characterDeckComponents.note: 女 (woman) — in ancient China, family names traced descent through the mother's line, tying 姓 to the woman radical.
生 (shēng) gives a sound distantly related to xìng, having drifted apart over time.

makemeahanzi.definition: guest, traveller; customer

etymology.hint: A person 各 welcomed under one's roof 宀; 各 also provides the pronunciation

characterDeckComponents.note: 宀 (roof) — represents a home.
各 (each, various) — a person arriving from elsewhere and welcomed under one's roof gave 客 its meaning 'guest, visitor.'

makemeahanzi.definition: level, rank; class, grade

characterDeckComponents.note: 纟 (thread) — 级 originally named a strand or rank of silk thread, extended to 'grade, level, rank.'
及 (jí) gives the sound — 级 is also pronounced jí, an exact match.

makemeahanzi.definition: food; to eat

etymology.hint: A dish of food 良 with a lid on top 人

characterDeckComponents.note: 人 — a lid covering the dish
良 — a dish piled with food

makemeahanzi.definition: to detain; to knock, to tap; button

characterDeckComponents.note: 扌 (hand) shows 扣 relates to an action done by hand, like fastening a button.
口 (kǒu) gives a sound close to kòu, sharing the initial consonant.

makemeahanzi.definition: to exist; to survive, to maintain; to keep, to store; to deposit

characterDeckComponents.note: 子 (child/seed) — 存's meaning 'to exist, survive' has been linked to a seed persisting to grow.
才 (cái) gives a sound hint — 存 is pronounced cún, sharing the initial consonant though the vowel and tone differ.

makemeahanzi.definition: incense; fragrant, aromatic

etymology.hint: A herb 禾 with a sweet 甘 smell

characterDeckComponents.note: 禾 (a grain plant) — a sweet-smelling crop
日 — here standing in for sweetness (originally 甘), giving the sense of a pleasant smell

makemeahanzi.definition: one hundred; numerous, many

characterDeckComponents.note: 一 (one) — relates to 百's meaning 'hundred,' a large round number built from 'one.'
白 (bái) gives a sound hint — 百 is pronounced bǎi, sharing the same base sound with a different tone.

makemeahanzi.definition: dizzy, faint, foggy; to see stars

characterDeckComponents.note: 日 (sun) — 晕 originally described a hazy ring around the sun or moon.
军 (jūn) gives a sound close to yūn, sharing the same rhyme though the initial has shifted.

makemeahanzi.definition: yellow; surname

characterDeckComponents.note: 黄 originally depicted a large ornamental jade pendant worn at the waist; the character was later borrowed for the color 'yellow.'

makemeahanzi.definition: theatrical plays, opera, drama; severe, acute

characterDeckComponents.note: 刂 (knife) contributes to the character's form, though its link to 剧's meaning 'drama' has faded over time.
居 (jū) gives a rhyme close to jù, with the tone shifted.

makemeahanzi.definition: snow; wipe away shame, avenge

characterDeckComponents.note: 雨 (rain) — 雪 belongs to the group of weather words built on 雨, since snow falls the way rain does.
彐 gives a sound distantly related to xuě, having drifted apart over time.

makemeahanzi.definition: expensive, costly; valuable, precious

characterDeckComponents.note: 贝 (shell, an ancient form of money) — 贵 relates to worth and cost.

meanings: to carry (i.e. publish in a newspaper etc)

makemeahanzi.definition: load; to carry, to convey, to transport

characterDeckComponents.note: 车 (cart) — 载 means to carry or transport by vehicle.
哉 (zāi) gives a rhyme close to zài, with the tone shifted.

makemeahanzi.definition: to catch, to seize; to arrive, to reach

characterDeckComponents.note: 辶 (to walk) — 逮 describes chasing and catching someone.
隶 (lì) gives a sound distantly related to 逮's reading dǎi, having drifted apart over time.

makemeahanzi.definition: mirror, glass; lens, glasses

characterDeckComponents.note: 钅 (metal) — early mirrors were made of polished bronze.
竟 (jìng) is an exact match for the sound of 镜.

meanings: to become rich by illegal means

makemeahanzi.definition: fat, plump, obese; fertile

characterDeckComponents.note: ⺼ (flesh) shows 肥 relates to a bodily state.
巴 (bā) gives a sound distantly related to féi, having drifted apart over time.

makemeahanzi.definition: printing block, edition; register; volume, version

characterDeckComponents.note: 片 (a slice/plate) — 版 originally referred to a wooden printing block
反 (fǎn) gives the sound — an exact match with 版's reading bǎn

makemeahanzi.definition: crooked, bent; wrong, false

characterDeckComponents.note: The outline pictures a bent, curved container or musical instrument, giving 曲 its meaning 'crooked, bent' and, by extension, 'a tune.'

makemeahanzi.definition: needle, pin, tack; acupuncture

etymology.hint: A metal 钅 pin 十

characterDeckComponents.note: 钅 (metal) shows what the object is made of.
十 pictures a thin, straight pin, giving 针 its meaning 'needle.'

meanings: (of a form etc) to fill in

makemeahanzi.definition: to fill, to pad, to stuff

characterDeckComponents.note: 土 (earth) — 填 originally meant to fill a space with earth or soil.
真 (zhēn) gives a sound distantly related to tián, having drifted apart over time.

meanings: to duck out of the way

makemeahanzi.definition: flash, lightning; to dodge, to evade

etymology.hint: A man 人 just glimpsed through a door 门

characterDeckComponents.note: 门 (door) frames the scene.
人 (person) glimpsed briefly inside, giving 闪 its meaning 'to flash, to dodge quickly.'

makemeahanzi.definition: iron; strong, solid, firm

characterDeckComponents.note: 钅 (metal) — 铁 refers to iron, a metal
失 (shī) gives a sound distantly related to 铁's reading tiě, having drifted apart over time

makemeahanzi.definition: already, since, then; both; de facto

etymology.hint: A person 旡 turning away from food 皀; compare 即

characterDeckComponents.note: 旡 — a person turning their head away
皀 — a dish of food, already finished with

makemeahanzi.definition: to hammer, to pound, to strike

characterDeckComponents.note: A hand with a stick — represents striking or hitting.
Gives the sound gāo, related to qiāo but drifted apart over time.

makemeahanzi.definition: to entwine, to wind around; to orbit, to revolve

characterDeckComponents.note: 纟 (thread) — 绕 describes winding thread, or anything else, around something.
尧 (yáo) shares the rhyme -ao with rào, though the initial has drifted from y- to r- over time.

meanings: classifier for clothes, mats, screens etc

makemeahanzi.definition: neck, collar; lead, guide

characterDeckComponents.note: 页 (head) — relates to 领's meaning 'neck, collar; to lead,' the head/neck area.
令 (lìng) gives a sound hint — 领 is pronounced lǐng, sharing the same rhyme with a different tone.

makemeahanzi.definition: to slip, to slide, to glide; slippery

characterDeckComponents.note: 氵 (water) — sliding and slipping evoke the smoothness of water.
留 (liú) gives the sound — a close match for liū, differing only in tone.

makemeahanzi.definition: mugwort, Artemisia vulgaris; used in transliterations

characterDeckComponents.note: 艹 (plant) — 艾 names a plant, mugwort.
乂 (yì) gives a sound distantly related to ài, having drifted apart over time.

makemeahanzi.definition: to assemble, to collect, to meet

etymology.hint: People standing side-by-side 乑, hand-to-ear 取

characterDeckComponents.note: 取 (a hand at an ear) — gathering information or people.
乑 (people standing side by side) — together giving 聚 its meaning 'to assemble, gather.'

makemeahanzi.definition: a line; to arrange, to classify

characterDeckComponents.note: 刂 (a knife, related to 刀) — cutting and arranging pieces in order ties to 列's meaning 'row, line, to arrange'

makemeahanzi.definition: wet, moist, humid, damp; illness

characterDeckComponents.note: Water — relates directly to wetness.
Gives the sound xiǎn, related to shī but drifted apart over time.

meanings: to push or move with a pole

makemeahanzi.definition: to support, to prop up, to brace; overflowing

characterDeckComponents.note: 扌 (hand) — 撑 describes propping something up with the hand.
掌 (zhǎng) is close in initial to chēng (both zh-/ch- are related retroflex sounds), though the rhyme has drifted.

meanings: (fig.) person with a particular undesirable characteristic

makemeahanzi.definition: insect, worm; mollusk

characterDeckComponents.note: 中 (zhōng) gives a sound close to chóng, sharing the same rhyme.

makemeahanzi.definition: to trust, to rely on; to appoint; to bear; duty, office

characterDeckComponents.note: 亻 (person) — 任 relates to a person taking on a responsibility or role.
壬 (rén) gives a hint of the sound — 任 is pronounced rèn, a connection that has shifted somewhat.

meanings: classifier for a dose of medicine

makemeahanzi.definition: dose; medicine; measure word for medicines

characterDeckComponents.note: 刂 (knife) relates 剂 to cutting or dividing something into a prepared dose.
齐 (qí) has drifted apart from jì over time, sharing little of the original sound match.

meanings: (bound form) meals (as in 伙食[huo3 shi2])

makemeahanzi.definition: companion, colleague; utensils

characterDeckComponents.note: 亻 (person) — 伙 relates to people who share meals or work together.
火 (huǒ) gives the sound — an exact match with 伙's reading huǒ.

makemeahanzi.definition: to respect, to honor; respectfully

meanings: to get in the way of

makemeahanzi.definition: to block, to obstruct; to get in the way; cover, guard

etymology.hint: A hand 扌 raised at the right time 当; 当 also provides the pronunciation

characterDeckComponents.note: 扌 (hand) — blocking something is done with the hand.
当 here contributes to the character's form, describing being raised up at the right moment.

makemeahanzi.definition: to shift, to move about, to drift

meanings: to push aside with the hand, foot, a stick etc

makemeahanzi.definition: to stir, to move, to distribute, to allocate

etymology.hint: To dispatch 发 goods by hand 扌

characterDeckComponents.note: Hand — shows this is an action performed by hand.
Represents something being sent out or distributed.

makemeahanzi.definition: promptly, quickly, immediately

etymology.hint: A hungry person卩 kneeling over food 皀; compare 既

characterDeckComponents.note: 卩 (a kneeling figure) — a hungry person kneeling down, about to eat.
皀 (a bowl of food) — the meal in front of them, giving 即 its sense of imminent action, 'right away, that is to say.'

makemeahanzi.definition: country, nation, state; national

etymology.hint: Treasure 玉 within a country's borders 囗

characterDeckComponents.note: 囗 (a boundary/enclosure) surrounding 玉 (jade, treasure) — a country pictured as protected, valuable territory.

makemeahanzi.definition: to pull, to stretch; to draw; to attract

etymology.hint: To pull back a bow's 弓 drawstring 丨

characterDeckComponents.note: 弓 (bow) — the weapon being drawn.
丨 depicts the taut drawstring being pulled back — giving 引 its meaning 'to pull, draw out, attract.'

makemeahanzi.definition: pine tree; fir tree

characterDeckComponents.note: 木 (tree) — 松 names a type of tree, the pine.
公 (gōng) gives a rhyme close to sōng, with the initial shifted.
